intent: The resizable shell shared by every left-rail panel (Composition, Assets, Agent). Owns the width and a drag-resize separator so the panels can't drift and a host-controlled width survives switching tabs.
use_when: A left-rail panel that must be resizable and share width with its siblings.
dont_use_when: A fixed-width rail — use a plain container.
The inspector rail — use InspectorRailSwitcher / Inspector.

tokens.note: Layout-only; width clamped to [200, 360], default 240; no hardcoded hex — verified.

a11y.role: separator (the resize handle; resizeLabel is its accessible name)
a11y.keyboard: the separator is operable for keyboard resize.
